subject: S08 owns: revoke client INSERT on attempts and INSERT/UPDATE on blocks
body: Today authenticated can insert attempts and insert/update blocks (incl. config, started_at) directly. A client-inserted attempt opens the attempt gate (question-linked cards, explanations) without server grading, and a client-written started_at would break S09 timer integrity. Since S08 writes blocks/attempts through the API with the service role, S08 adds an Alembic migration revoking those privileges from authenticated (keep SELECT under RLS), updates tests/db/test_rls.py + live_check expectations, and adds a db test that a student JWT cannot insert an attempt or update blocks. S09 will add its select-only block_sections table on top.
